name: DG Film Look by Danny Gevirtz
recipeDetail:
Comments from the Creator
The DG Film Look is designed to elevate the emotional impact of video footage shot in all situations, whether outside in bright sunlight or indoors in low-light conditions. The colors and look were created to evoke the feel and nostalgic memories of release prints made for projection in cinemas.
The DG Film Look can be applied in-camera to instantly give the video footage you are recording a more dense, cinematic look that recalls the color palettes of legendary, classic film stocks. To achieve this look, the highlights have been softened to be more neutral, and the blacks are kept rich, all the while achieving an overall clean image. As the look is geared towards shooting human-drama fiction pieces and documentaries, you can get movie-like skin-tone colors and a Hollywood-style-inspired look in any shooting situation, in any weather, heightening the impact on your audience, whatever the story you are telling.
